Name: Cook's Tools Meat Compatibility
Author: GoodJobSuzette
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27697]Novaphene's Cook's Tools[/url] contains two useful meat items, Chicken and Pork. This compatibility patch expands their use by making them fully functional with popular meat and meat alternative mods.

[b]What this compatibility mod does is:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Allows for the Pork and Chicken to be "unwrapped" and converted to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry [/url]meat or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023]Rosa's Cruelty-Free[/url] meat through the kitchen menu
[*]It expands input in the Air Fryer so that Animal Husbandry chicken may be used to create Novaphene's original Fried Chicken while Rosa's cruelty-free chicken will create Rosa's Fried Chicken ([i]new in 1.1[/i]) & Pork will create Rosa's Fried Pork ([i]new in 1.2[/i])!
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]This patch works by adding new recipes to your kitchen that convert the Chicken and Pork from Cook's Tools into their Animal Husbandry or Rosa's Cruelty-Free Meat equivalents, so the only potential conflict is another mod that uses the same recipe structure to convert these specific items. 
[*]If you encounter an issue, please let me know & I will try my best to solve it!!
[/list]

[b]FOR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30838]HOME COOKING[/url] USERS: [/b] there is no need to install Cook's Tools Meat Compatibility as this compatibility is already present within Home Cooking 1.5.8+ :)
